The offsetting drag, and the reason this is not scored higher: shares went 149M → 162M → 175M in six months (+17.4%) on continuous ATM issuance against ~$50M/quarter burn and $209M of cash — the "unmoved" price is partly the company selling into its own good news, and that dilution compounds until the events resolve.
analysis: Both flagged events verify as real, hard, dated and fully forward, and the residual-capture test — which kills most names in this lane — passes cleanly here: the catalysts have been publicly knowable since January yet the stock is 6.7% BELOW its pre-catalyst base and 13% below its post-FORWARD-data print, so essentially none of the upside has been harvested. The capital structure carries no preferred and $175M of net cash, so the equity waterfall fully supports the upside and no analyst target was inherited; re-derived from the ground up, tanruprubart alone justifies roughly the current $623M EV, which means ARCHER II is being carried at zero. The two real haircuts are that ARCHER II's primary endpoint prospectively tests a post-hoc visual-acuity finding from a Phase 2 that MISSED its own lesion-growth primary — a genuine coin flip that the Month-24 dual-primary addition tacitly concedes, even though the market shrugged it off (5.34 to 5.26 on 2026-08-12) — and that relentless ATM issuance (+17.4% shares in six months against ~$50M quarterly burn) is eroding the per-share claim while the clock runs. kill_fact: FORWARD is NOT the statistically significant Phase 3 - it is an open-label US/EU generalizability bridge, and that bridge is the reason the BLA slipped a full year. The stat-sig pivotal was the 2024 Bangladesh/Philippines Phase 3 (ANX005 30mg/kg, 2.4x GBS-DS improvement at Wk8, p=0.0058; the 75mg/kg arm MISSED). Annexon guided a BLA off that data for 2025; FDA instead required a "generalizability package," pushing submission to Q4-2026 with FORWARD (early data = first 10 patients, open-label) as the supporting set. So the BLA is not a mechanical filing off a clean pivotal - it rests on an FDA-negotiated bridge from a non-Western population that has already caused one 12-month slip, and the same agency posture can slip it again past Q4. Second correction: net cash is ~$159M, not $175M - $209.2M cash/ST investments at 6/30/26 LESS $50M already DRAWN on the $200M Oxford facility; that is senior secured debt sitting ahead of the common, so "no preferred, clean waterfall" is right in kind but overstated ~10% and omits the drawn tranche. Against ~$55M/qtr net loss ($55.3M Q2, $0.28/sh) the cash column is ~3 quarters, which is precisely why the ATM keeps running into the print. What SURVIVES intact: both events are real, company-guided, dated and fully forward (Month-15 ARCHER II primary "on track for Q4 2026," Month-24 dual primary ADDED while retaining Month-15, completion Q3-2027; BLA "expected in Q4 2026"; EU MAA submitted 2026-01-08 and confirmed still under review at the 8/12 Q2 release). The already-harvested test passes decisively and has strengthened since the line was written: ANNX trades $4.87, BELOW both the 50d ($5.38) and 200d ($5.39) averages, 32% under the $7.18 52wk high, and down another 7.4% from the $5.26 8/12 print the line cited - the catalysts have been public since January and the tape has faded them, not paid them. EV recomputes to ~$639M (163.8M shares x $4.87 = $798M cap, less $209M cash, plus $50M debt), close enough to the line's $623M that the "ARCHER II carried at zero" framing holds. Net: thesis stands, two load-bearing facts wrong, and the BLA's regulatory certainty is materially lower than "off a statistically significant Phase 3" implies - trim 7 to 6.

analysis: The event is real, dated, forward and unfired: QUELL-CV is dosing, the topline is company-guided to year-end 2026, and the ~63% de-rate on 2026-07-31 was caused by Novo Nordisk's failed Phase 3 ZEUS outcomes trial (ziltivekimab, IL-6), not by any BioAge data — so the asymmetry the triage describes does exist, and the balance sheet backs it with roughly $7/share of net cash by the readout against a $9.59 price, i.e. the market assigns ~$100M of enterprise value to a best-in-class oral NLRP3 asset. The reason this stays WATCH rather than ACTIVE is that the sell-off was information, not noise: ZEUS was the validating outcomes read for the whole residual-inflammation CV thesis, and BGE-102's Phase 2 is a biomarker (hsCRP) trial whose result is already largely demonstrated in Phase 1 — a clean print re-rates the asset only if investors are willing to re-underwrite a class thesis that a Phase 3 just failed, which the readout provides no evidence for. kill_fact: Primary source (CRK 8-K ex-99.1 / GlobeNewswire, 2026-09-01) confirms the spine exactly: LOI with SOCAR, $1.65B cash for 20% of Legacy Haynesville WI + 15% of Western Haynesville WI + 15% of CRK's 73% Pinnacle stake; PSA targeted 2026-10-31, close by year-end, effective date 2026-07-01; pro-forma net debt $3.1B -> $1.5B (halving, exact). (2) NUMERATOR IS INFLATED BY A REVERTING INTEREST: SOCAR's Western WI drops 15% -> 7.5% after five years once SOCAR clears a 15% ROI, so SOCAR is paying for a partly temporary interest; marking the permanent retained ~81% off that per-unit price overstates the SoP. Netting Pinnacle at the Sixth Street mark (10.95% of $2.2B = ~$241M) leaves ~$1.41B for the upstream slice, and the read-through to ~$8.7B whole-asset depends entirely on an unverifiable Legacy/Western value split. Post-deal sell-side sits at GS $15 (2026-09-02) and Mizuho $20 Neutral against a "Reduce" consensus - $18.75 is the top half of that range, not a conservative floor. (3) RELATED-PARTY PROMOTE IS BIGGER THAN A "HAIRCUT": the 71%-controlling shareholder's family partnership carries 85%/80% of D&C on 27 wells with only 50% reverting after a 15% ROI - a standing drain on minority common, not a rounding item. But axis 1 is half-fired (the LOI itself was the re-rate; what remains binds only good-faith negotiation) and the residual is a levered Henry Hub proxy in a downtrend where gas beta can swamp the event. Real, dated, big - just not the 7-grade clean waterfall claimed.

analysis:
The triage note has the trust figure wrong in the investor's favor and the upside wrong in the opposite direction: trust was $244,162,068 on 23,000,000 public shares = $10.62/share at 6/30/26 (not ~$10.45), so at $10.65 the position sits roughly AT trust today and ~1.3% BELOW the ~$10.79 redemption value at the 11/12/26 outside date — a real contractual floor, with zero redemptions to date and no extension deposits needed. analysis: The dated forward event is real and verified - FDA reset the deramiocel PDUFA to 22 Nov 2026 on 24 Aug 2026 after accepting a major amendment that narrows the sought indication to upper-limb function, the HOPE-3 endpoint that actually hit (PUL 2.0, p=0.029, Lancet July 2026) - and the FDA choosing to extend rather than simply issue a CRL on the 22 Aug date is a genuine, if thin, positive tell. Real, cheap, unfired, correctly dated — but the "binary, mechanical, non-extendable" premise that justified a 6 does not survive the rule text.

bloom_gates: G1 PASS — named counterparty Gentherm Incorporated, definitive RMT agreement signed. G2 PASS — concrete commitment: $800M committed financing secured, regulatory approvals received, dated shareholder meeting scheduled. G3 FAIL — no currently-unpriced specific figure: the $1.0B transaction value, ~6.8x post-synergy EBITDA, $210M cash and 40/60 split were all disclosed 2026-01-29 and the stock re-rated +20.3% in that single session.

Re-derived numerator (no analyst target inherited): MOD holders' consideration is 40% of NewCo, which at THRM's current $1.25B standalone equity (that being the 60% side) marks at ~(40/60)x$1.25B ≈ $833M, plus $210M cash to the parent — ~$1.04B total, i.e. ~10% of MOD's $10.34B market cap, and that value is already inside the current price because it is Modine's own segment, not an incoming payment. The trigger's premise ("de-rated rather than priced") does not survive: the -40% from the $323 high is a post-announcement melt-up unwinding on data-center-cooling sentiment, not the spin going unpriced. analysis: The event is real, specific and dated — definitive RMT with Gentherm, $800M committed financing, regulatory clearances done, a Sept 10, 2026 THRM vote and a Q4 2026 target close — so G1 and G2 pass cleanly. But it is not unpriced: MOD closed $146.90 on 2026-01-28 and jumped to $176.72 on the 2026-01-29 announcement (+20.3%), and at $194.66 the stock is +32.5% above the pre-catalyst base; the drawdown the trigger reads as "de-rated" is measured from a $323 post-announcement peak driven by data-center-cooling enthusiasm, not from an unpriced structural event. Re-deriving the numerator rather than inheriting one: the 40% NewCo stake marks at ~$833M off THRM's live $1.25B cap plus $210M of cash, ~10% of Modine's $10.34B market cap and already inside the share price, leaving essentially no mechanical remaining capture — and the Sept 10 vote, needing a majority of all outstanding THRM shares with MOD holders having no vote, is a downside binary for MOD rather than an upside trigger. Mostly-harvested event with the residual thesis resting on data-center cooling demand, which is a thematic bet and out of scope: cap at 4, WATCH the vote and the IRS ruling as deal-break risk markers, not as an entry.

analysis: The event is genuine, hard-dated and forward — a signed cash-and-stock merger with both shareholder votes carried on 2026-06-30, HSR already cleared, and only foreign antitrust plus money-transmitter licences outstanding ahead of a 1Q27 close — so it clears the reality, dating and non-macro gates cleanly (G1+G2; G3 fails because nothing about the payoff is unpriced). Worse, the 36% stock leg is a naked fixed 0.1574 ratio with no collar: BCO has already fallen ~16% since announcement (destroying more per-share value than any plausible break-risk discount), and a further ~6% BCO decline turns the spread negative even on a perfect close, so only the hedged pair expresses the event and even that pays a thin coupon for tail risk. Capped at 4 per the mostly-harvested rule; WATCH rather than ACTIVE, and it would only become interesting on a wide-spread dislocation (NATL below ~$44 against an unchanged BCO) or a disclosed collar/price bump.

analysis: The triage bundle is half-stale: the Provident Bancorp acquisition is not "fully approved" and pending — it received all regulatory approvals 2025-10-20 and CLOSED 2025-11-15, roughly ten months ago, so that leg is fired and long since re-rated, leaving only the December-2026 restriction lapse as forward. The behavioral evidence actively cuts against the takeout read — a bank that spent 2025 buying Provident and is steadily retiring its own stock at ~$20 is running the consolidator/compounder playbook, not positioning to sell at the three-year mark. catalyst: Boliden AB signed a definitive agreement 2026-08-27 to buy Votorantim's 64.68% of Nexa (0.250 Boliden shares per Nexa share) and contractually agreed to commence a voluntary CASH tender for all remaining minority shares within 30 days of closing (60 in certain circumstances), at a price equal to 0.250x Boliden's 20-day Nasdaq Stockholm VWAP prior to closing.
dated_milestone: Signed 2026-08-27. Next dated gates: Boliden extraordinary general meeting to authorize the share issue (notice not yet published as of 2026-09-06); regulatory/competition clearances; Closing expected Q1-2027; minority cash VTO to commence within 30 days of Closing (60 under certain circumstances); separate Peruvian mandatory tender offers for listed Nexa subsidiaries within ~6 months of Closing.
instrument: common equity (NEXA, NYSE); a clean spread requires shorting 0.25 BOL.ST per NEXA share, since the cash consideration floats with Boliden's stock
bloom_gates: G1 PASS (named counterparties: Boliden AB / Votorantim S.A., definitive agreement 2026-08-27). G2 PASS (concrete contractual commitment: "take all lawful actions to commence a VTO to purchase for cash any of Nexa's shares not acquired through the Transaction" within 30/60 days of Closing; Boliden EGM + antitrust conditions; Q1-2027 close). G3 FAIL ON MAGNITUDE - the figure is specific and re-derivable (0.250 x SEK 547.60 / 9.5643 = $14.31 vs $13.80) but it is only 3.7%, not the ~10% flagged, and it is not a fixed number - it floats with Boliden's share price and USD/SEK.
edge: L. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: the last unaffected day was 2026-07-01 (Boliden's speculation statement); the $15.29 signing value was a 14.2% premium to the then 20-day average, implying an unaffected base of ~$13.39. NEXA ran to $15.58 by 2026-08-26 (+16% vs base) but round-tripped -9.7% on the 08-27 announcement to $14.07 and sits at $13.80 - so net run-up is only ~+3% vs the unaffected base; the event is NOT harvested. Remaining capture is nonetheless thin: $13.80 to the mechanically re-derived implied VTO of $14.31 = +3.7% gross over ~7 months to a Q1-2027 close plus 30-60 days to VTO launch (~6% annualized before borrow), and that 3.7% is only earned if you short 0.25 BOL.ST - unhedged, this is a levered long on Boliden/zinc, not an arb.
analysis: The event is real, dated, forward and contractual - named counterparties, a signed definitive agreement, and an explicit commitment to a cash tender for 100% of the minority within 30 days of a Q1-2027 close - so G1 and G2 pass cleanly and nothing has fired. But the triage's economics are wrong on two counts. First, the $15.29 is not a fixed cash price for minorities: the VTO price is 0.250x Boliden's 20-day VWAP at closing, so re-deriving it at today's BOL.ST SEK 547.60 and USD/SEK 9.5643 gives $14.31, not $15.29 - the gross spread is 3.7%, not ~10%, and the "10%" only exists by inheriting a 2026-07-01 reference price. Second, the claim that the stock has "not yet re-rated to terms" is inverted: NEXA fell 9.7% on the announcement (from $15.58 to $14.07) because the terms landed BELOW the market, and it has since drifted to $13.80, roughly back at its $13.39 unaffected base - the market has already priced the deal, just downward. What remains is a ~3.7% floating spread that is only capturable by shorting 0.25 Boliden per share; naked, the position is a zinc/copper equity proxy, which is exactly the macro-bet exclusion. Real event, quantified residual, but the residual is too thin and too commodity-contingent for an ACTIVE seat - WATCH, and re-rate if Boliden re-rates higher or NEXA dislocates below ~$12.50 while the agreement stands.

catalyst: Neogen's definitive agreement to sell its global animal-genomics business (GeneSeek, ~$90M FY25 sales) to Zoetis for $160M gross / ~$140M net, with proceeds contractually earmarked for debt paydown, closing by the end of fiscal H1-2027 (~Nov 30, 2026).
dated_milestone: Deal close by end of H1 FY2027 = on/before 2026-11-30 (regulatory approval outstanding); nearer checkpoint = FQ1-FY2027 earnings ~2026-10-01, where management restates the "below 3x net leverage by end of calendar 2026" commitment.
instrument: common equity (NASDAQ: NEOG)
bloom_gates: G1 PASS (named counterparty Zoetis, definitive agreement signed 2026-03-02); G2 PASS (concrete dated commitments: $160M gross/$140M net proceeds to debt reduction, net leverage below 3x by end CY2026 and ~2.5x by end FY2027, $20M term-loan paydown already made late June 2026); G3 FAIL (no specific currently-unpriced figure — the $140M is 5.4% of the $2.58B market cap and is a balance-sheet transfer, not incremental equity value).
edge: L. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base: last close before the 2026-03-02 announcement was $11.23 (2026-02-27); today $11.83 = +5.3%. The event itself was NOT rewarded — the stock fell 11.15 -> 9.65 (-13%) in the week after the announcement; the +141% move off the $4.90 52wk low is core Food-Safety/Petrifilm recovery and earnings beats, not this deal. Remaining capture to the provenance-checked favorable resolution: ~0-5%. Re-deriving the numerator from the capital structure (FY2026 balance sheet, 5/31/26): gross debt $793.3M, cash $185.5M, net debt $607.8M, ZERO preferred stock, no external manager, no PIK stack, no structural claim ahead of the common — so the full $140M accrues to common, but as cash-for-asset-for-debt it is mechanically value-NEUTRAL to equity. Worse, $160M on ~$90M of segment sales is 1.8x sales vs the parent's own ~3.6x EV/sales ($3.19B EV / ~$895M revenue), i.e. the asset leaves below the consolidated multiple. The only real upside is a soft, non-contractual re-rating from ~3.3x net leverage (Q4 adj EBITDA $45.4M -> ~$182M run-rate) toward sub-3x. So: unfired and barely priced, but there is almost nothing TO price.
analysis: The event clears the reality and dating bars cleanly — signed definitive agreement, named investment-grade buyer (Zoetis), hard close window (end of fiscal H1-2027, ~Nov 2026), proceeds explicitly ring-fenced for debt, and a management-stated sub-3x net-leverage target by end-CY2026 reaffirmed on the 2026-07-30 FY26 call — and it is genuinely unfired and un-harvested (only +5.3% versus the pre-announcement close; the stock actually sold off 13% in the week after the news). The disqualifier is the numerator, not the calendar: with no preferred ahead of the common and no manager rake, the re-derived waterfall shows the entire $140M reaching equity yet creating essentially zero mechanical value, because it is a cash-for-asset swap into debt, transacted at 1.8x segment sales versus the parent's own ~3.6x EV/sales — the flagged "deleveraging upside" is a multiple-re-rating hope, not a contractual figure. Scoring the EQUITY rather than the EVENT per the FIP rule: the shares sit 8% below the 52wk high after a 141% run, at roughly 17-18x post-close EV/EBITDA on ex-genomics earnings, so the equity does not rescue the thesis either. Real, dated, forward, not macro — but capped at 4: a WATCH for the close confirmation and the CY2026 leverage print, not an ACTIVE seat.

instrument: None / watch-only. If ever taken: small common only — options on a $582M de-SPAC are thin and the equity carries a de-SPAC warrant/earnout overhang.
bloom_gates: G1 PARTIAL — counterparties are named (Uvation ~100 units for data centers, Ameresco ~50 units, Boldrocchi helium-circulator supply) but every offtake is an explicitly non-binding MOU/LOI. G2 FAIL — no binding commitment; company itself describes the ~$4B / ~200-unit book as non-binding MOUs (YE-2025). G3 FAIL — no specific currently-unpriced figure survives derivation; the $4B headline is an un-probability-weighted aggregate and the $21.90 high is a de-SPAC pop print, not a value.
edge: L. RESIDUAL CAPTURE: run-up from the pre-catalyst base is ~0% — the readiness review was announced 23 Jul 2026 and the assessment 19 Aug 2026, yet at $5.27 the stock sits on its 200d avg ($5.25) and below its 50d ($5.34), so the licensing arc is genuinely not harvested. But remaining capture is UNQUANTIFIABLE, not large: there is no provenance-checked favorable-resolution value to measure the remaining % against, because a readiness assessment grants nothing (it only permits a better-quality filing) and no binding revenue exists to discount. So the "un-priced" claim is half right — un-run-up, but also un-anchorable, which is the opposite of an edge.
analysis: The event is real, dated and forward — the NRC did commence a six-week limited-scope preapplication readiness assessment of nine PSAR chapters and the Environmental Report off a 10 Aug 2026 entrance meeting, and it is un-run-up (price $5.27 is flat to the 200d avg of $5.25 despite the 23 Jul and 19 Aug announcements). What it is not is an asymmetry anchored to value: a readiness assessment confers no authorization, the CPA submission date is a company target rather than a regulatory deadline, and the entire commercial book (~$4B / ~200 SOLO units across Uvation, Ameresco, Rock City, Waiken) is disclosed as non-binding MOUs, so Bloom G2 and G3 both fail outright. The capital structure kills the rest of the case: $91.1M cash against a $207.1M de-SPAC warrant/earnout liability stack and negative $115.5M book equity, on a $582M pre-revenue market cap — the flagged "un-priced licensing arc" cannot be re-derived to any number the common can actually reach, and the $21.90 reference is a de-SPAC pop, not a valuation. Watch the ~late-Sept readiness-assessment completion and the actual CPA docketing as the points where a real dated regulatory anchor first exists; until a binding offtake converts or the warrant/earnout overhang resolves, this is a thematic microreactor option, not a catalyst trade.

analysis: Real, dated, forward and non-macro: upLIFT topline is genuinely unfired, the FDA has committed in writing that this single-arm 16-patient study can support registration, and the responder bar is a specific number (9/16) rather than prose. But the June 2, 2026 interim already published 6 of 8 responders, which both moved the stock +26.9% off its $3.61 pre-event base and stripped most of the informational surprise out of the print — what is left is a high-probability pass with a violent failure tail, plus a "2H 2026" date so vague it cannot be sized or timed. Compounding it, the upside numerator is unquantified (Rezolute has never sized tumor HI; the $11.46 high belongs to the congenital-HI thesis that failed on 2025-12-11 and whose FDA re-review has no date at all), and a $120M cash box against ~$340M of enterprise value makes a raise into the catalyst a live risk. Verdict: keep on the board as WATCH, but this is a mostly-harvested, negatively-skewed print rather than an ACTIVE seat — the moment worth acting on was June 1, and the next legitimate re-look is the FY2026 10-K (~late Sept) if it puts a month on the topline or a number on the market.
